Figure 5: Confidence sets of endpoint-conditioned couplings and their widths

Figure 1: Illustration of optimal and non-optimal couplings with common marginals. The optimal coupling reallocates mass through local movements and attains the minimal transport cost D(µ, ν) = 0.5. The non-optimal coupling has the same marginals but uses a longer jump from category 1 to category 3, resulting in a larger transport cost of 0.7.

Figure 2: Illustration of representative endpoint-conditioned optimal couplings under missing data. The lower-endpoint coupling attains the smallest discrepancy consistent with the observed data, while the upper-endpoint coupling attains the largest. In this example, both couplings remain concentrated near the diagonal, but the upper-endpoint coupling involves larger adjacent-category reallocations.
